Title: Generally Available: New vector data type and functions in Azure SQL

Body.Content:
Azure SQL now supports vector data types for efficient storage, querying of embeddings, and semantic search, making it an ideal database for AI. Now you can integrate advanced AI capabilities into your applications, resulting in smarter and more responsive systems. 

 

With AI agents poised to autonomously interact with databases, centralizing secure data becomes even more critical to prevent unauthorized access. The robust security features in Azure SQL—including advanced threat protection, encryption, and compliance with industry standards—help to safeguard your sensitive data. Native row-level security further restricts access to specific data, helping to prevent malicious prompts and rogue agents from gaining access to unauthorized data. 

 

Combined with full-text search support, Azure SQL streamlines application architectures. You get true multi-model and modern developer features all in one place, eliminating integration overhead and reducing complexity. And there’s no need for specialized external vector databases or full-text search engines.  

 

Vector data support, comprehensive security, dynamic scalability, simplified architectures, and full-text search combine to make Azure SQL a robust and scalable foundation for building intelligent, responsive AI systems with confidence and ease. 

 

Learn more.
